semiconductor_relevance: None — Tahinium Technologies is not directly involved in the semiconductor supply chain but focuses on IoT solutions for smart street lighting.
summary: Tahinium Technologies Private Limited specializes in smart street lighting solutions using its IoT management platform, CitiLight. The platform allows cities to retrofit existing lighting systems with controllers for real-time monitoring and energy analytics, enhancing operational efficiency and sustainability.
